title: The Expedited Charge Worked on the Confirmed Ceiling
content:
# Costing Note: The Expedited Charge Worked on the Confirmed Ceiling

This note defines the charge for expedited handling on a work order of the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service and works it to a figure.

## The quantities

**The ceiling.** The figure standing on the most recent authorisation the customer has confirmed on the work order.

**The rush rate.** The level's own rush share.

**The charge for holding the bench open out of hours.** Nothing is added for holding the bench open out of hours.

**The whole of the expedited charge.** The expedited charge enters at the whole of itself, 100 percent, and the relief the member is allowed is taken off that whole.

**The relief the member is allowed.** The relief the member is allowed is nothing, and the relief is taken off the expedited charge alone.

**The ceiling share.** The narrow ceiling share, 25 percent of the ceiling.

## The charge

The charge for expedited handling is worked out on the ceiling standing on the most recent authorisation the customer has confirmed on the work order. The charge is that ceiling taken at the rush rate, with the charge for holding the bench open out of hours added and the relief the member is allowed taken off, and it is never more than the ceiling taken at the ceiling share; every figure is rounded to the nearest cent. The charge that stands is therefore the lower of the two: the ceiling at the rush rate with the out-of-hours charge added and the relief taken off, and the ceiling taken at the ceiling share.

## Worked to a figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a hypothetical work order at a level whose rush share is 30 percent, with a confirmed authorisation standing at a ceiling of 2,000.00 USD.

- The ceiling at the rush rate of 30 percent is 600.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent.
- Nothing is added for holding the bench open out of hours, and nothing is taken off as relief, so the charge before the ceiling share stands at 600.00 USD.
- The ceiling taken at the ceiling share of 25 percent is 500.00 USD.
- The charge is the lower of 600.00 USD and 500.00 USD, rounded to the nearest cent: 500.00 USD.

Had the ceiling stood at 1,000.00 USD instead, the ceiling at the rush rate would be 300.00 USD and the ceiling share 250.00 USD, so the charge would be 250.00 USD.
